title: GenAI Hub - Regional Failover and Routing
description: Shows whether APIM's multi-region failover policy actually routed traffic away from Sweden Central. Tiers: Sweden Central primary, East US 2 secondary, West Europe tertiary. Region is derived from the backend URL on each gateway log.

list.name: deployment
list.label: Model deployment
list.description: Filter every panel to one or more model deployments.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where isnotempty(Dep)
| distinct Dep
| order by Dep asc

panels.title: Served by Primary
panels.description: Share of model calls served by Sweden Central, the primary region. Anything well below 100% means the failover policy is actively diverting traffic.

| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Total=count(), Prim=countif(Tier == '1 Primary') by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| project TimeGenerated, PrimaryShare = 100.0 * Prim / Total
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Region Health Comparison
panels.description: Reliability and latency per region. Worth checking whether the primary is genuinely the best place to serve traffic - if a failover region is faster and more reliable, the routing priority deserves review.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(responseCode_d >= 400),
            ServerErrors=countif(responseCode_d >= 500), Throttled=countif(responseCode_d == 429),
            P50=round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)),
            Deployments=dcount(Dep) by Tier, Region
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2),
         ['Share %'] = round(100.0 * Calls / toscalar(
             AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT'
             and Category == 'GatewayLogs' and isnotempty(tostring(backendUrl_s)) | count), 2)
| project Tier, Region, Calls, ['Share %'], ['Error %'], Throttled, P50, P95, Deployments
| order by Tier asc

panels.title: Deployment Routing Matrix
panels.description: Where each model deployment was actually served. Failover % is the direct answer to 'was it routed'. A deployment at 0% never left the primary; one near 100% is effectively running from a backup region.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(),
            Primary=countif(Tier == '1 Primary'),
            ['East US 2']=countif(Tier == '2 Secondary'),
            ['West Europe']=countif(Tier == '3 Tertiary'),
            Errors=countif(responseCode_d >= 400),
            P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Deployment=Dep
| where isnotempty(Deployment)
| extend ['Failover %'] = round(100.0 * (['East US 2'] + ['West Europe']) / Calls, 2),
         ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2)
| extend Routing = case(['Failover %'] == 0, 'Primary only',
                        ['Failover %'] >= 90, 'Failover only',
                        ['Failover %'] >= 10, 'Split', 'Mostly primary')
| project Deployment, Calls, Routing, ['Failover %'], Primary, ['East US 2'], ['West Europe'], ['Error %'], P95
| order by Calls desc

options.content:
### Policy behaviour

`frag-backend-routing` wraps the call in `<retry count="3">`, firing when the backend returns **429** or **5xx** and at least one alternate route is free.

Route order is by `priority`, lowest first:

| Tier | Region |
|---|---|
| Primary | Sweden Central |
| Secondary | East US 2 |
| Tertiary | West Europe |

### Why triggers and failover do not line up in time

When a route fails, the policy marks it `isThrottling` with a `retryAfter`, then **caches that for up to 3600s**. Every later request skips the parked route until the timer clears.

So a single throttle at 23:00 can keep traffic on the secondary region for the next hour with **no further errors logged**. Do not expect the trigger chart and the failover chart to line up - compare them, do not correlate them minute by minute.

### One more caveat

APIM writes **one** GatewayLogs record per client request, showing the **final** backend. Retries inside a request are not logged separately, so these panels show where requests *ended up*, not how many attempts it took.

panels.title: Failover Triggers - 429 and 5xx by Region
panels.description: The errors that mark a route as throttled. Compare shape with the failover chart above, remembering the cache means effect lags cause by up to an hour.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where responseCode_d == 429 or responseCode_d >= 500
| extend Kind = strcat(Region, iff(responseCode_d == 429, ' 429', ' 5xx'))
| summarize Events=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Kind
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Backend Route Detail
panels.description: Traffic per configured APIM backend, mapped to its region and tier. Use this to confirm each model's routes resolve to the backends you expect.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',
                     Region == 'East US 2',      '2 Secondary',
                     Region == 'West Europe',    '3 Tertiary', '4 Unclassified')
| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(responseCode_d >= 400),
            P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), Deployments=dcount(Dep)
            by Backend=tostring(backendId_s), Region, Tier
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2)
| project Backend, Region, Tier, Calls, ['Error %'], P95, Deployments
| order by Calls desc

panels.description: Which consuming applications had their traffic served from a non-primary region. Relevant where data residency or latency commitments apply.

| extend BU = tostring(backendUrl_s), Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(BU)
| extend Region = case(BU has '-swc-' or BU has 'swedencentral', 'Sweden Central',
                       BU has '-eus2-' or BU has 'eastus2',      'East US 2',
                       BU has '-euw-'  or BU has 'westeurope',   'West Europe',
                       'Other')
| extend Tier = case(Region == 'Sweden Central', '1 Primary',

| extend OnFailover = Tier in ('2 Secondary', '3 Tertiary')
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
